userConstraint: Volunteer store cannot obtain permits, phytosanitary/health/origin certificates, or special regulatory approvals. Routine postal/customs declarations and simple recipient arrival declarations or personal-use undertakings are distinguished from certification. Any mandatory separate agency registration or advance notice must be identified explicitly.
scope: Japanese finished steamed/dried Camellia sinensis tea, sealed 100 g retail pouches, personal use by postal recipient.
acceptance: Each destination needs a source-backed no-special-document decision; unresolved research is not completion. Mandatory documents make route unsuitable unless an applicable exemption is verified.
